offering_description.value: Develops and sells prescription medicines for ADHD, Parkinson’s disease, postpartum depression, epilepsy, migraine prevention and other neurological conditions. It uses contract manufacturers and supplies the US market through pharmaceutical wholesalers, retail and specialty pharmacies, and commercialization partners.

primary_products.value: nonstimulant ADHD medicines; Parkinson’s disease medicines and infusion therapies; oral postpartum depression medicines; extended-release epilepsy and migraine medicines; therapeutic botulinum toxin injections

customer_segment.value: B2B: Pharmaceutical wholesalers, retail and specialty pharmacies, and healthcare practices that purchase clinician-administered medicines

end_markets.value: ADHD treatment; Parkinson’s disease care; maternal mental health; epilepsy and migraine care; other movement disorder care

revenue_model.value: product sales: Prescription medicines sold through wholesale and pharmacy channels; licensing or royalties: Rights to commercialize selected prescription medicines in licensed territories

value_chain_position.value: brand owner: Develops or licenses medicines, uses contract manufacturers, and supplies wholesalers, pharmacies and healthcare practices

geography_served.value: US national: United States for direct commercialization, with select overseas rights held by partners

specialization.value: related lines: Prescription treatments for ADHD, Parkinson’s disease, postpartum depression, epilepsy, migraine and other neurological conditions

distribution_channels.value: distributors / dealers: Pharmaceutical wholesalers that supply pharmacies and healthcare providers; third-party retail: Retail and specialty pharmacies that dispense prescriptions to patients; partners / resellers: Pharmaceutical partners that co-commercialize or license selected medicines
distribution_channels.category: distributors / dealers; third-party retail; partners / resellers

regulatory_exposure.value: high: FDA approval, manufacturing standards, safety reporting and promotion rules for prescription drugs

notes: Geography reflects direct commercialization, and the full current reach of overseas licensees is uncertain.
